title: Billing Dispute Case Log (2026)
body:
Purpose
- Track all 2026 billing disputes (Hosted + Dedicated) with: amount at risk, root cause category (meter bug vs misunderstanding), resolution, and approvals.
- Source of truth for Finance close + Support escalations. Keep entries current; link to Jira ticket + any PR/Linear work.

Key
- Root cause category: METER_BUG | DATA_PIPELINE | CONTRACT_ATTRIBUTION | CONSOLE_UI_MISMATCH | CUSTOMER_MISUNDERSTANDING | PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFUSION | OTHER
- Disposition: NO_ADJUSTMENT | CREDIT_ISSUED | REFUND_ISSUED | INVOICE_REISSUED | DOCS_UPDATE | ENG_FIX_SHIPPED
- Approval rules (internal):
  - <= $5k credit: Emily Stone approval (Finance) + Support lead acknowledgement
  - $5k–$25k: Laura Bennett approval + Legal notified (Sofia Mendes)
  - > $25k or contractual interpretation: Laura Bennett + Michael Grant (GC)

Notes / TODO
- TODO (Emily): ensure every dispute >=$5k has legal notified + a written customer explanation attached in Jira.
- TODO (Dev): link all disputes with 'usage mismatch' to the standardized reconciliation query and attach CSV export.
- TODO (Chloe): after pr_41941, verify that console defaults explicitly show the same time window as invoice (UTC calendar month) + surface model alias mapping.
- TODO (Nadia/Logan): once retry dimensions land (ENG-4823), update triage runbook to require request_outcome breakdown before considering credits.
- Reminder: For any credit due to confirmed metering defect, attach: impacted window, customer ids, query evidence, PR/commit hash, and prevention plan for CFO context.
